other_conditions: Units must have their operations in Goa.
The applicant must be one of: Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, Limited Liability Partnership.
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar.
benefits_summary: 20% subsidy on power charges up to ₹5,00,000 per year per unit for up to 3 years.
